name: GRACE
description: A benchmark for evaluating language model calibration by comparing model confidence and accuracy to human calibration. It uses question-answer pairs with clues of increasing ease to measure how early and confidently models answer correctly, enabling granular calibration assessment.
reputation: A recent calibration benchmark that has begun to attract attention in the LLM evaluation community, but it is not yet a widely standardized or heavily adopted leaderboard benchmark.
notes: Includes live human vs. model competitions; measures timing, accuracy, and confidence; highlights model miscalibration compared to humans.
